art_direction: 浅长春花底，间距稍近，双眼含笑左望，亲近又克制。
composition_variation: Bring the eyes moderately close. Raise the right center and lift its outer corner subtly; make the left a fuller relaxed half-moon. Both pupils glance left without crossing. Slightly lift the lower contours for a faint smiling impression, keeping warmth understated rather than cutesy. Preserve exactly TWO eyes with the SAME iris hue, large black pupils and one slim elongated ivory glint each. Emotion comes only from the eye geometry and gaze. Use matte gouache, organic curved tapered boundaries and a visibly pale colored ground; no eyebrows, mouth, head, sclera or other marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
